summary_1line: Vamadeva instructs that a wise king consolidates power, avoids unnecessary war, rules justly, and expands only when his strength and resources are secure.

image_candidates.scene_text: A calm king restrains his anger while advisers stand around him, symbolizing the ruler who conquers his temper rather than his enemies.
A small but disciplined army marches confidently under a royal banner, representing a well-governed kingdom capable of subduing greater lands.
